stem: How did the Voting Rights Act of 1965 contribute to the changes shown in this table?

options.label: F
options.text: It helped reduce voter discrimination at polling sites.

options.label: G
options.text: It increased state revenues associated with poll taxes.

options.label: H
options.text: It contributed to increased involvement of lobbyists in political campaigns.

options.label: J
options.text: It helped voters determine educational policy based on literacy test results.
